use_case_summary: Primary goal: replace manual context switching for contact center agents across insurance, billing, and clinical triage. Agent-assist: real-time suggestion cards, auto-fill templates, and one-click tool-calls to EHR. Ticket summarization: condensed PHI-aware notes for QA and audit. Scale target: 250-350 concurrent agent sessions, burst tolerant to 2x during incident spikes. Latency target: <250ms suggestion generation 95p, 99p under 500ms. Cost sensitivity moderate — prefer predictable reserved capacity. Must run in customer VPC with strict egress controls and per-request audit logs; retention policy configurable up to 7 years for compliance and legal hold.
notes: Initial inbound via partner channel (health-tech integrator).

Prefer VPC Private deployment or on-prem with Redwood control plane in SaaS-only if KMS in-customer required.

Red flags: legal asks for data residency in US-only, wants all PHI redaction options + local KV cache only in VPC.
AE note: price sensitivity vs reliability — finance prefers reserved predictable pricing, ops leans to private deployment.
